description.value: Jood Halal Meats And Grocery is a halal-certified butcher and grocery store in Vancouver, offering halal meats alongside general grocery items. For touring cyclists navigating the city, it serves as a resupply stop with a focus on halal products not always available at mainstream supermarkets. The OSM record was verified as recently as February 2026.

address.value: 757 E Broadway, Vancouver, BC V5T 1X8, Canada
